name: integrated-agent-workflow
description: Coordinate native agents in one chat or authorized parallel manager chats under HQ, with optional read-only CLI advisers.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate agents and manager chats under HQ.
interface.longDescription: Use native sub-agents in one chat by default. With explicit task-creation authorization, split independent work into Astra/Sol manager chats supervising task-fit Terra/Luna/Spark workers while the current HQ owns integration and final validation. Optional external CLI and LM Studio advisers remain read-only, and model availability follows each active tool schema.
defaultPrompt: Run a multi-agent review of this change.
Coordinate Astra, Sol, Terra, and Luna sub-agents by task fit.
Keep this Astra chat as HQ and create Sol manager chats for independent workstreams, using task-fit native workers.
Use gpt-5.3-codex-spark for a focused fast subtask.
